live_repository_state_at_checkpoint.basis: GitHub compare 50346642..8f592dcc lists documentation/governance/evidence files only; no src/ or reference/ paths changed. The F-VQ99 scientific target therefore remains the pinned Status-A product image.

external_b0_asset.source: user-supplied official SWAP_4.3.1.zip; external evidence only; not committed to public repository

b1_10_reconstruction.method: Exact B0 plus the immutable qualified patch chain in repository order, with corrected-target SHA checked after every patch. SWAP-012 used its repository byte-safe apply_and_verify authority rather than approximate diff application.

local_compiler_execution_adapter.purpose: Execute immutable legacy source in the current Linux runner after the official Intel-linked executable could not load libimf.so.
adapter_rules: Translate only Intel !DEC$ conditional compilation directives to equivalent temporary cpp guards for linux/multiswap/with_animo/with_sss.
Compile TTUTIL from the exact distribution source because the shipped TTUTIL archive contains Intel-runtime-linked objects.

Use Intel-like persistent-local semantics for ordinary legacy files; compile only MOD_RIA.f90 and temperature.f90 with automatic locals because their PURE procedures are incompatible with gfortran SAVE semantics.
Apply the identical compiler adapter to B0 and B1.10.

normalization_before_execution: SWCSV=1 -> SWCSV=0 for both B0 and B1.10, reusing the pre-existing historical gfortran/testbank execution normalization; this changes legacy CSV output control only and is not a scientific parameter or tolerance change.
Remove stale outputs before each run.
hupsel_execution_contract.completion_rule: Legacy process returns code 100 at shutdown in this ported execution path; successful completion requires generated swap.ok stating simulation successfully terminated plus newly generated result outputs.

hupsel_output_evidence.representation_difference: The B0/B1.10 raw files differ only in the '* Generated at:' timestamp line.
hupsel_output_evidence.normalization_for_identity: Convert CRLF to LF and remove only the complete '* Generated at:' line.
hupsel_output_evidence.classification: Scientific Hupsel balance content is I_IDENTICAL after the declared representation normalization; the unnormalized raw-file difference is IV_IO_OR_REPRESENTATION_ONLY_DIFFERENCE because it is limited to generation timestamp.

evidence: The Status-A baseline explicitly limits qualification claims to stated admitted scopes and classifies broad public API / wholesale legacy IO modernization as future scope.
src/runtime/mod_fmr_deterministic_runtime.f90 is explicitly a deterministic test model with scalar water storage and supplied inflow/outflow; it is not the SWAP physical application.

src/runtime/mod_fmr_serialized_reference_backend.f90 is a real physical interval backend, but its canonical forcing already requires prepared top_flux, bottom conditions, drainage controls/sources and root_extraction_sink. It does not consume the Hupsel meteorology/crop/legacy input set and does not itself provide canonical crop/ET/meteo/IO application composition.
src/runtime/mod_fmr_serialized_kernel_backend.f90 is a generic injected-kernel transaction wrapper and likewise does not define Hupsel application semantics.

The current source tree contains qualified process/runtime/test surfaces but no authoritative end-to-end application entrypoint mapping the official Hupsel fixture to the full set of Status-A interval forcings and process controls.
swap5_long_trajectory_assessment.why_not_build_an_ad_hoc_driver: A campaign-written Hupsel-to-SWAP5 application mapping would have to choose currently unbound crop/meteo/ET/forcing composition semantics. That would introduce new decision semantics into the oracle path and would not be an independent verification of an existing canonical application. F-VQ99 is evidence-only and must not silently implement the missing application boundary merely to obtain PASS.

verdict_interpretation: The prior missing-B0/Hupsel-asset blocker has been resolved and the complete legacy Hupsel authority is now qualified. No unexplained scientific/numerical difference was found. Global equivalence remains unestablished only because a canonical current-SWAP5 application-level mapping for the declared long Hupsel trajectory, and a directly comparable B1.10 persisted-state restart fixture, are not established.
next_permitted_actions: Treat the recovered exact B0/B1.10 Hupsel reference and normalized output hashes as immutable external evidence for future application-level qualification.

If whole-model Hupsel equivalence is required, open a separately governed application-composition qualification/implementation workunit that first defines or admits the canonical mapping from legacy Hupsel meteo/crop/ET inputs to SWAP5 typed forcing/process composition; only after that mapping is fixed may EQ-FULL-HUPSEL-LONG be executed against it.
Alternatively, pursue the existing independent restart-fixture route if a semantically equivalent B1.10 persisted-state fixture can be established without inventing a mapping.
Do not widen tolerances, change production physics, or treat seam-level PASS results as a substitute for the declared whole-trajectory comparison.
